# DSL002: abbreviated-ticket-id

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | DSL |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | file |
| fix | deterministic |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A directive carries an abbreviated ticket id instead of a full 26-char ULID.

Only full ULIDs persist in tracked text (D24). Handles (`~3M8Z4T7`, bare
7-char forms) and v1 `T-0042` forms must be replaced with the full id that
`frob ticket show <handle>` prints.

## Examples

### DSL002 abbreviated ticket id / Handle form #1 (line 6) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:ticket ~3M8Z4T7 */ // error: DSL002
fn a() {}
```

### DSL002 abbreviated ticket id / Seven-character handle in a todo #2 (line 13) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:todo 3M8Z4T7 later */ // error: DSL002
fn a() {}
```

### DSL002 abbreviated ticket id / Abbreviation in a ticket= key #3 (line 20) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:defer COV006 because=x ticket=~3M8Z4T7 */ // error: DSL002
fn a() {}
```
